name: smwpatches-extended-overworld-level-names-v1
title: Extended Overworld Level Names v1.2
description:
This patch allows you to have level names of 38/56 characters long, distributed into 2 rows of 19/28 character each. Originally made by Smallhacker. Minor tweaks and improvements by Ayami.

Be sure to check the Info & Changelog text file included, for information on how to make the patch to work.

yoshifanatic's update:
- Made this patch compatible with asar 2.0.
- Merged this patch with Alcaro's Extended "Extended OW Level Names" variant by giving the user the ability to toggle the behavior they want.
- Changed the error message, as Lunar Magic inserts the level name ASM hack when saving the overworld, not necessarily the level names.
- Made this patch compatible with Lunar Magic's optional expanded level/event slot ASM hack.
